findings.title: Phase III Open-Label, Randomized Clinical Trial of Epidermal Growth Factor and Growth Hormone Releasing Hexapeptide in Acute Ischemic Stroke (COURAGE-2, J Clin Neurosci)
findings.whatChanged: A phase 3 trial of GHRP-6 (with EGF) that MISSED ITS PRIMARY ENDPOINT: no difference in mRS, Barthel index or survival in the ITT population (n=188); benefit only in a severe-stroke subgroup (NIHSS>=15, n=27). Negative headline result with a positive subgroup is exactly the shape this site exists to report honestly. DOI 10.1016/j.jocn.2026.112195.
